name: popsicle
headline: bespoke: open source mailchimp alternative
short_description: Bespoke is an open-source, self-hostable email marketing platform positioned as a Mailchimp alternative. It is built for developers and teams who want full control over their email marketing infrastructure.
author: bespoke-surf

sections.overview:
Bespoke is an open-source email marketing platform designed as a self-hostable alternative to Mailchimp. It gives developers and businesses full ownership of their email marketing stack without relying on third-party SaaS pricing or data policies. The project is structured as a monorepo with web and server applications, and includes Docker support for straightforward deployment. Bespoke is suited for technical teams who need a transparent, customizable email marketing solution they can run on their own infrastructure.
Self-hosting an email marketing platform instead of paying for Mailchimp
Running email campaigns on your own infrastructure for data privacy
Deploying a branded email marketing tool using Docker
Building and managing subscriber lists without third-party SaaS dependencies
